_comment: Supplemental browser signing certificates absent from Google's upstream
by scripts/ci/checkPasskeyPrivilegedBrowserAllowlist.sh on every sync; entries here survive updates.
- Fingerprint must be SHA-256 of the X.509 signing cert of an APK downloaded from the
vendor's OFFICIAL release channel (never a third-party re-signing repo such as the
F-Droid main repo, which signs with its own per-app keys).
- Record acquisition provenance in '_source' (URL of the exact artifact verified).
- Only 'release' build entries are trusted at runtime; userdebug/test keys are ignored.
- Never add AOSP public test keys (see PasskeyOriginVerifierTest).
- Never add apps whose official artifacts are signed with Android Debug keys.
